note: Transcribed row-by-row from Amazon's published Associates Program Standard Commission Income Statement (S04) on 2026-11-13. Rates are the published fixed rates for the US program; they change without notice, so the platform re-reads this page on each research cycle instead of caching it as truth. BOUNTY COMPLETION (2026-11-14, session d3ce1c29, flag F-30 — renumbered from F-27 to F-30 on merge because main took F-27/F-28/F-29): the 'Bounty events' panel originally published 9 rows under a 'transcribed row-by-row' notice, while S04 publishes 46 rows under '(a) Bounty Events' and a further 2 under '(b) Bonus Events'. The partial list was replaced with the full transcription and the Bonus Events block was added. The 9 original rows were individually correct; the defect was omission, not error.
